description_en: Queries the SSL configurations of a cluster
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-db-cluster-ssl --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-000000000000 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusterSSL

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/612393.html接口查看集群所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口查看目标地域下所有AnalyticDB MySQL集群的详情，包括集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

ConnectionString.description_en: The endpoint that is protected by SSL encryption

ExpireTime.description_en: The validity period of the SSL certificate. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ(UTC time)
ExpireTime.description_zh: SSL 证书有效期。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC 时间）

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request

SSLEnabled.description_en:
Indicates whether SSL encryption is enabled. Default value: true. Valid values:

true: enabled
false: disabled
SSLEnabled.description_zh:
是否开启SSL。
取值： 
true：开启。
false：关闭
